column6: Deseret News 2025-07-29 reports Impact Utah will cease operations July 31 after a state audit of MEP-fund misuse; 47G Impact Center page still describes the joint venture in present tense.
Dated listing for an April 16 2026 workshop at Indie Square Murray; official work-here page also lists current vacant suites with monthly rates, but that copy is undated.
WTC Utah dated 2026-04-10 release covers the GOEO-partnered governor trade mission to Switzerland and Germany April 13-21 2026; GOEO also posted a conclusion writeup of the same mission.
Cedar City/Iron County ED grants page posts the 2026-2027 Small Business Grant cycle with pre-applications September 1-20 2026 and awards November 2 2026.
Official workshops page lists upcoming 2026 surgical teaching workshops including Ghana oncology August 14-23 2026 and Nigeria pediatric urology September 11-20 2026.
UIPA 2025-04-08 release quotes Juab County ED director Brent Boswell on the Ash Grove Leamington plant incentive; county business page itself is still a coming-soon stub.
JustBuild-presented AI Builder Day Part 2 is scheduled for August 14-15 2026 in Lehi; official event page lists the weekend, registration, and JustBuild as presenter.
Gardner Institute 2026-01-16 news release: presented the 38th Economic Report to the Governor at the 2026 Economic Outlook and Public Policy Summit; homepage also lists August 2026 research briefs.
SponsorCX 2026-05-18 release: additional Series A investment led by Kickstart, with partner Tanner Potter quoted as board member; FAQ also says Fund VI is actively deploying.
Kiln 2026-05-11 press release: Preston Hollow location opening May 18 2026 and Plano later in 2026; Utah locations remain in the network.
Official homepage lists the 43rd Annual Investors Choice Conference on September 3 2026 in Midvale with applications now open.

Homepage and about page describe advisory, investment, and pitch competitions with no dates; pitch-competition URL 404s; searches found no 2025-2026 cohort, award, or filing for LiaLaunch itself (founder public record is Scribbi).
Utah Public Radio 2026-07-09 reports the Logan Target at the former mall site opening July 26 2026, the Cache Valley Marketplace project Logan ED director Kirk Jensen had been the city contact for.
Official homepage events widget is set to August 2026 week 33; Meetup upcoming list was empty when checked, so the dated calendar on the org site is the signal.
KUTV 2025-06-24 covers a June 25 2025 MakeUtah and TribeAngels hardtech showcase at doTERRA HQ; May 2025 newsletter also lists a June 19 Third Thursday pitch.
Maven SLC Create page posts a lease promo of six weeks free plus two extra weeks if move-in by September 1 2026, with an August 1-31 2026 window; members portal had no upcoming events listed.
PR Newswire via intelligence360 2025-08-21: Wellth $36M Series C led by Mercato Partners (March 2025 close); Mercato newsroom itself still tops out at 2024 posts.
MIDA board-meeting summary dated June 26 2026 records FY2026-27 budget adoption, Camp Williams Lunar Resources sublease, and Falcon Hill site-plan approvals.
Chamber event calendar lists chamber-hosted 2026 dates including the November 14 banquet and December 4 Swanny Park tree lighting.
Official homepage solicits daily votes for Northern Utah 2026 Best Reception Center for Monarch Venues; no separately dated public events calendar was opened.
Space events log lists a December 1-5 2025 U.S. Department of Energy Legacy Management contractor booking; no upcoming 2026 events were posted when checked.
Chamber hosted Morgan Spectacular 4th of July Celebration 2026 on July 4 with parade, vendor, and regatta registration; wiki had recorded the domain as parked in July 2026 but the site is live now.
Morgan County Commission 2026-02-03 work session is noticed for Northern Utah Economic Alliance and Inland Port Authority; county grant page describes a July 15 close with no year stated.
Official full-time enrollment page is accepting 2026-2027 applications with Quarter 1 enrollment closing August 21 2026 at 3:00pm.

MAG FY26 approved budget (July 1 2025-June 30 2026) funds the Small Business Loan Program; magutah.gov apply pages still take year-round applications with a monthly committee cutoff. Heber Valley RLF page is undated.
